formatting.name: no-ai-list-formatting / emoji list items
formatting.summary: Decorative emoji (✅ ❌ 💡 🚀 …) inside markdown list items read as machine-generated structure.
formatting.why_it_matters: Upstream: flashy emoji in list items give a mechanical impression; human tech writing in JA rarely decorates bullets.
rewrite_strategy: Drop the emoji, keep the label as plain text.

formatting.name: no-ai-list-formatting / bold-label list items
formatting.summary: List items shaped like `- **label**: description` (or dash-separated) are an AI-typical list template.
formatting.why_it_matters: Upstream: bold+separator list items look machine-generated; plain `label: description` reads natural.
rewrite_strategy: Unbold the label or drop the bold+separator template.

formatting.name: no-ai-emphasis-patterns / emoji + bold combo
formatting.summary: Emoji immediately followed by bold text (✅ **高速**) is a machine-emphasis signature.
formatting.why_it_matters: Upstream: the emoji+bold combination gives a mechanical impression in prose and lists alike.
rewrite_strategy: Keep one emphasis device at most: drop the emoji or the bold.

formatting.name: no-ai-emphasis-patterns / bold info prefixes
formatting.summary: Bold generic info labels (**注意**, **重要**, **例**…) read as machine formatting.

regex: \*\*(検出される例|推奨される表現|設定例|使用例|良い例|悪い例|サンプル|おすすめ|ポイント|チェック|確認|補足|参考|メモ|注意|重要|推奨|例)(?:[：:][^*]*)?\*\*

formatting.why_it_matters: Upstream: bolded generic labels give a mechanical impression; context sentences make prefixes unnecessary.
rewrite_strategy: Write the note as a plain sentence instead of a bolded label.

formatting.name: no-ai-emphasis-patterns / bold in headings
formatting.summary: Bold (or __underline-bold__) inside a markdown heading is redundant: the heading is already emphasis.
formatting.why_it_matters: Upstream: heading text is already emphasized; nested bold is redundant and typical of generated docs.
rewrite_strategy: Remove the bold markers, keep the heading text.

hype.name: no-ai-hype-expressions / absoluteness (weak intensifiers)
hype.summary: Absolute/completeness intensifiers (完全に, 最高の, 大幅に…) — common in legitimate JA prose, weak signal.
hype.why_it_matters: Upstream suggests concrete numbers instead of absoluteness. These words also occur in normal prose, so desloper triages them P2 (weak).
rewrite_strategy: Replace with the concrete number or degree where possible.

hype.name: no-ai-hype-expressions / abstract effect
hype.summary: Abstract/metaphorical effect hype (魔法のように-family; 革命的-family live in the phrases scanner).
hype.why_it_matters: Upstream: metaphorical abstract claims lack verifiable content; concrete mechanisms read credible.
rewrite_strategy: State the concrete mechanism or outcome instead of the abstract effect.

hype.name: no-ai-hype-expressions / predictive authority
hype.summary: Authority/prophecy hype (業界を再定義-family; overlapping entries live in the phrases scanner).
hype.why_it_matters: Upstream: prophetic industry claims are boilerplate; concrete change descriptions read credible.
rewrite_strategy: Name the concrete change instead of declaring inevitability.
